+    temperature = float(parameters.get("temperature", 0.2))
+    gamma = float(parameters.get("residual_tangent_weight", 0.1))
+    loss_weight = float(parameters.get("loss_weight", 1e-4))

+    if codebook.ndim != 2 or codebook.shape[1] != source.shape[1]:
+        raise ValueError("codebook must have shape [C, D]")
+    if mask.shape != (source.shape[0],):
+        raise ValueError("mask must have shape [B]")

+    target_logits = target @ codebook.transpose(0, 1) / temperature

+"""Directed residual/codebook tangent-transport auxiliary objective.
+
+This module is intentionally standalone: it depends only on PyTorch and accepts

+

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute masked source-weighted overlap plus residual tangent geometry."""
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    temperature = float(parameters.get("temperature", 0.2))
+    gamma = float(parameters.get("residual_tangent_weight", 0.1))
+    loss_weight = float(parameters.get("loss_weight", 1e-4))
+    if source.ndim != 2 or target.shape != source.shape:
+        raise ValueError("source and target must have matching [B, D] shapes")
+    if codebook.ndim != 2 or codebook.shape[1] != source.shape[1]:
+        raise ValueError("codebook must have shape [C, D]")
+    if mask.shape != (source.shape[0],):
+        raise ValueError("mask must have shape [B]")
+
+    valid = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype)
+    denom = valid.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
+    source_logits = source @ codebook.transpose(0, 1) / temperature
+    target_logits = target @ codebook.transpose(0, 1) / temperature
+    source_prob = torch.softmax(source_logits, dim=-1)
+    target_prob = torch.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1)
+
+    overlap = (source_prob * target_prob).sum(dim=-1)
+    overlap_term = -torch.log(epsilon + overlap)
+
+    residual = target - source
+    residual_direction = residual / (torch.linalg.vector_norm(
+        residual, dim=-1, keepdim=True
+    ) + epsilon)
+    source_to_code = codebook.unsqueeze(0) - source.unsqueeze(1)
+    source_geometry = source_to_code / (torch.linalg.vector_norm(
+        source_to_code, dim=-1, keepdim=True
+    ) + epsilon)
+    tangent_alignment = (residual_direction.unsqueeze(1) * source_geometry).sum(-1)
+    tangent_term = (source_prob.detach() * (1.0 - tangent_alignment.square())).sum(-1)
+
+    per_pair = overlap_term + gamma * tangent_term
+    return loss_weight * (per_pair * valid).sum() / denom
